title: Lamb Kebabs with Mediterranean Flair
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the taste of lamb with the richness of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Cut lamb shoulder into 1-inch cubes and season with salt, pepper, and Mediterranean spices.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb with olive oil and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Meanwhile, toast the pita bread and top with feta cheese, mixed bell peppers, red onion, and fresh parsley.
Drizzle lemon juice over the salad and serve with the lamb kebabs.
